title: Mixed Duo #033 · 여 토운드 밤쉘·반바 / 남얼굴 블랙 글래머·글래스 스킨
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright bamboo grove with a smooth stone path, tall green bamboo on both sides, a waist-high bamboo fence and a standard gate, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Japanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a copper barrel-shaped weight, a gold ship's anchor, an iron round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a silver cube-shaped block, a silver ship's anchor, a bronze small flared temple bell, an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal bracelet. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a striking young male model face with sharp straight brows, a strong chin and a visible Adam's apple, a very faint trace of stubble, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth golden-tan skin, a relaxed half-smile, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a silver round bell, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a copper barrel-shaped weight, a gold cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal necklace. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold work boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
